The laboratory uses HVF outside and nested TCG; production KVM isolation is not certified.
The TUI remains an initial reduction; upstream agent wording, advanced CLI paths and other network/download paths still need review.
Experimental UI variants and every advanced CLI path are not yet covered by the restricted-surface tests.
